verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS and API video-generation product like Luma. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, usage-tracking controls, or data-collection settings. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
